measures.code: Adopter lines (R) and supplier lines (K, cumulative)
measures.continuity: Uses of unrelated claims and sections refused during the run. Must be 0
measures.declaration_work: Adopter actions to record the declarations: proposals, confirmations and edits
measures.false_alarms: Notices on claims the oracle marks unaffected, split into label-limited and structural
measures.leaks: Any identifier, field or content a recipient may not read. Must be 0
measures.missed_alerts: Oracle-affected claims with no notice at the responsible institution, split into label-limited and delivery misses
measures.notice_completeness: Notices with all six fields equal to the oracle, divided by notices delivered
measures.repair_work: Adopter actions from the notice to a resolved state per claim
measures.setup_and_configuration: Commands and decisions to the first exchange, under frozen P1.7 rules
